result_text:
I fixed the three default-convention bugs in `ScopingConventions.java`. The related existing tests pass, and a temporary check of the real convention lists confirmed the new matches. I didn't commit.

The changes, all in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML (`addGeneratedConventions`, the pkgdown, Doxygen and meta-generator rules):** the path pattern was `.*[.](html|html|xhtml)`, a duplicated `html` where `htm` was meant. It is now `.*[.](htm|html|xhtml)`.
- **.NET XML documentation rule:** the path pattern was `.*/[.]xml`, which only matched a file named `.xml`. It is now `.*[.]xml`.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by` rule:** the path pattern was `.*/[.]js`, which only matched a file named `.js`. It is now `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle script rule (`addBuildAndDeploymentConventions`):** the pattern was `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js`, which only matched `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`.

The temporary check confirmed that a pkgdown, Doxygen or meta-generator `.htm` page, a `<doc>` XML file (`MyAssembly.xml`), a `// Generated by` `app.js` and `build-gradle.js` are now matched. It also confirmed that `.html`, `.xhtml`, `build.gradle` and `.-gradle.js` still match, and that hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files do not. I then deleted that test, so the repo has no new test files.

`SourceFileFilterTest`, `CodeConfigurationTest` and `SourceCodeFilesTest` pass offline. I did not run the full module test suite.
